Original mod notes (1.4):
I have always considered Rimworld a survival game, so every mod that adds some grade of difficulty catch my interest. Like many admirers of Hardcore SK, with the pass of time I learned to create my own modpack, following the same philosophy: The more problems you have, the more interesting it will be your story... For that purpose, in my opinion Expanded Woodworking is a must-have mod for any player who wants to overcome some challenge.
MOD This is a revisited edition based on the forked mod made by Mercenary, upon Adventurer's version, which already was an upgrade of Qwynn's Expanded Woodworking [followed by Aquiles for 1.4, and thus to Zaljerem.]
New with Biotech! Polluted trees now produce rotten wood. Rotten wood cannot be converted into lumber, but can be restored into generic wood.
FEATURES
Trees, saguaro, and bamboo have their own unique wood. Polluted Trees, like witchwood, produce also their own: rotten wood. Every wood type (except saguaro and rotten wood) has a corresponding lumber. Process logs into lumber at the woodworking table. Restore rotten wood into generic to gain some raw materials in heavily polluted maps. Lumber is used in both construction and in crafting. Supports any starting scenario through using the crafting spot. Raw logs are used as fuel! Realistic wood colors! Compatibility with any mod using wood as a fuel item.
Patches Included (I don't use many of these mods, so I wasn't able to test them all) [All are untested, left alone from 1.4]
Advanced Biomes Biome Expansion: Redwood Forest Biomes! Prehistoric (+TMore Floors, +WD Expanded Floors, +VFE-Architect) (New!) Combat Extended Gulden Biome [LTS] Furnishing (New!) Medieval Overhaul Unofficial (+TMore Floors, +WD Expanded Floors, +VFE-Architect) (New!) More Trees (Continued) Nature's Pretty Sweet (Continued) (New!) [RF] Realistic Planets ReGrowth: Aspen, Boreal, Swamp, Temperate and Tundra (New!) [T] More Floors (thanks to Holgast) (New!) Tribal Essentials Reborn Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Architect (New!) Vegetable Garden Project (NOT Fruit Trees) (New!) VGP Xtra Trees and Flowers (New!) WD Expanded Floors (New!) Yayo Combat 3 (Continued) (New!) Zal's Smoked Meat Zen Garden (Continued) (New!) ... and more! NOTE: If you want to contribute writing a patch of your favorite mod, feel free to do it.
COMPATIBILITY [I don't guarantee any of this. :)]
Expanded Woodworking is fully compatible with everything else, because any unpatched tree will still provide generic wood and any unpatched floor will still be available. However, it may conflict with other mods if both directly overwrite the WoodLog definition, like e. g. Not a Weapon mod or Medieval Overhaul. To make it compatible with Medieval Overhaul, I recommend using this mod. Any bug report without a log may and will be deleted.
